message.content:
The cover illustration features an orange background with a large white header "TEMPO" and a logo reading "TEMPO 45 1971-2016." Above this, black text reads "PERUSAHAAN TAKSI DI BALIK DEMO RUSUH," and below it, "28 MARET-3 APRIL 2016." A man with glasses, wearing a short-sleeved dark blue button-down shirt and matching trousers, is depicted in a three-quarter view. He stands with his left hand in his pocket and his right hand adjusting his spectacles.

The man stands on a yellow measuring tape that extends diagonally across the lower half of the frame. The tape is suspended over a deep, rocky chasm with sheer brown cliffs. Small white clouds float around the base of the cliffs. The measuring tape spans the gap, supported by the cliff edges. To the right, bold black text reads "WASWAS SUMBER WARAS." In the bottom right corner, a barcode sits next to pricing information "RP 39.500" and the website "WWW.TEMPO.CO." The illustration uses a comic-style hatching and shading technique.
